1.content: Assign a high rating to moves that strictly reduce the Manhattan distance to the goal; give a low or negative rating to moves that keep the distance unchanged; and assign an even lower rating to moves that increase the distance, to discourage stagnation and backtracking.

2.content: Assign a very low (near-zero or negative) rating to any move that would step onto a known hazard cell, regardless of its effect on Manhattan distance, ensuring hazardous moves are never selected over safe alternatives.
